test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The teacher found it difficult to __exceed on__ the students’ request.
solution:
The correct answer is **"accede to"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, "exceed on" is incorrect instead of this we need to use "accede to"
 
• Here, "accede" means "agree to a demand, request, or treaty."
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker wants to say that "the teacher was in difficulty because he was not able to accept the students' request." 
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• It is doubtful whether the government will ever **accede to** the nationalists' demands for independence.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-** *The teacher found it difficult to **accede to** the students' request.*
